cases.name: batch runs several statements in one call

tasks.command:
__d=$(mktemp -d)
(
cat ref/docs/b.md
) >"$__d/0.out" 2>"$__d/0.err"; echo $? >"$__d/0.rc"
(
echo oops >&2; exit 3
) >"$__d/1.out" 2>"$__d/1.err"; echo $? >"$__d/1.rc"
(
duckdb -json -c 'select count(*)::int as c from read_json_auto('"'"'ref/events/**/*.ndjson'"'"', union_by_name=true)'
) >"$__d/2.out" 2>"$__d/2.err"; echo $? >"$__d/2.rc"
for i in 0 1 2; do printf '%s %s %s %s\n' "$i" "$(cat "$__d/$i.rc")" "$(base64 < "$__d/$i.out" | tr -d '\n')" "$(base64 < "$__d/$i.err" | tr -d '\n')"; done
